rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for describing someone who respects and fulfills their duties toward their parents.

example.english: He is filial and goes home after work to eat with his parents.
example.traditional: 佢好孝順嘅，放工就返屋企陪阿爸阿媽食飯。
